headline: Pilandok Slightly Intensifies as Three Tropical Depressions Strengthen Habagat
seoTitle: Pilandok Intensifies, Strengthens Habagat | FMB News
seoDescription: PAGASA says Tropical Depression Pilandok slightly intensified to 55 km/h as three tropical depressions strengthen Habagat rains over Luzon and western Visayas.
deck: Pilandok remains far east of Extreme Northern Luzon, but the combined weather systems are strengthening monsoon rains over parts of the country.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: PAGASA said Tropical Depression Pilandok slightly intensified early Monday while remaining over the Philippine Sea east of Extreme Northern Luzon. It had maximum sustained winds of 55 km/h near the center and gusts up to 70 km/h.
Pilandok and two other tropical depressions are helping enhance the southwest monsoon, bringing occasional to heavy rain over large parts of Luzon and western sections of the Visayas.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: As of the 5 a.m. bulletin, Pilandok was about 1,130 kilometers east of Extreme Northern Luzon and was almost stationary. No tropical cyclone wind signal was in effect.
PAGASA said Pilandok could briefly become a tropical storm before leaving the Philippine Area of Responsibility around Wednesday evening or early Thursday.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The immediate risk is not direct landfall but stronger monsoon rain, which can worsen flooding and landslide risk in areas already saturated by days of bad weather.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Follow PAGASA rainfall warnings, local evacuation orders and later cyclone bulletins. Conditions can change quickly even while Pilandok remains offshore.
